headline: STE Q1 Earnings Beat, Revenues Miss, Stock Dips in Aftermarket Trading
summary: STERIS beats fiscal Q1 earnings estimates as sales rise 7.3%, but a modest revenue miss sends shares 2.4% lower after hours.
